help_menu:
Click the buttons below to get information about my commands.
Note: All commands can be used with /
help_play: Play commands: /play followed by a song name, a YouTube link, or reply to any audio/video file - plays it, or lines it up if something is already playing. /vplay does the same with video. Add -f to jump the queue and play right now, -v to force video. Example: /play pal pal dil ke paas
help_control: Playback control (admins only): /pause - pause the stream. /resume - resume it. /skip - jump to the next song. /stop - stop everything and leave the voice chat. /loop - replay the current song that many times, or /loop off. /autoplay on - keep playing related songs when the queue ends, or /autoplay off.
help_seek: Seek inside a song (admins only): /seek - jump forward. /seekback - go back. Minimum is 10 seconds. Example: /seek 30
help_queue: Queue: /queue - shows the song playing right now plus everything waiting after it.
help_auth: Trusted members: Some people aren't admins but still need to control the music. Authorize them: /auth - reply to the person (or give their user id). /unauth - take it back. /authlist - see who is authorized.
help_admin: Group admin tools: /reload - refresh the admin list the bot uses. Handy right after promoting someone, so they don't have to wait. /settings - play mode and language buttons for this group (admins only to change). /lang - change the group language (admins only).
help_blist: Blacklist (owner only): /blacklist followed by a chat or user id blocks them from the bot. /unblacklist removes the block.
help_ping: Basic commands (work anywhere): /ping - bot speed, uptime and system load. /start - start the bot. /help - this menu.
help_stats: Numbers: /stats - chats served, assistants, sudo users (owners also get system stats). /ac - how many voice chats are live right now. /activevc - list them.
help_sudo: Sudo users (owner only to change): Sudo users can manage playback anywhere, like a second owner. /addsudo - add one (reply or user id). /rmsudo - remove one. /sudolist - see the list.
help_broadcast: Broadcast (owner only): Reply to any message with /broadcast and it goes out to every group and user the bot knows. Add -user to include private chats, -nochat to skip groups, -copy to drop the forwarded tag.
help_system: Owner toolbox: /eval - run a code snippet. /logs - get the log file. /logger on|off - turn play logging on or off. /restart - restart the bot.
